title: gymnadenia conopsea subsp. intermedia
intro: Gymnadenia conopsea subsp. intermedia, commonly known as the intermediate summer-reserring Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the genus Gymnadenia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia conopsea subsp. intermedia include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and have a sedative effect on the nervous system. Its bioactive constituents include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
